before_after_original_checks: Two complete non-following reads per observed input, exact full9 unchanged, and both bytes match SHA-256. All archived copies reread and authenticated.
classification: Exact historical authoring bytes preserved as inert recovery data. Includes no runtime custody, maintained integration, qualification, or launch authority.
limits_and_exclusions: Operational message-only directories, credential recovery and key directories, and system-private temporary directories were excluded.
No recursion into .git, datasets, generated material, git-object-views, or any other subtree.
Source4 directories contribute only their top-level authored scripts. No captured source bodies, epochs, assets, databases, binaries, logs, or runtime state.
Only exact .py, .py.DATA, .patch and .diff suffixes were eligible. Credential marker matches would be reported only by type, path, metadata and digest.
scope: Top-level Python sources and patch or diff files in the 29 post-cutoff /tmp directories from the named held metadata. No directory descendants entered.
